finding.preliminary_assessment: The VULN-020 fix is partially implemented: intervalId is correctly typed (ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null), stored on polling start, and cleared in checkHostScreenUpdate() to prevent duplicate intervals. stopHostScreenUpdate() is correctly defined. However, stopHostScreenUpdate() is never called anywhere in the codebase. The NavigationService is an @Injectable({providedIn: 'root'}) singleton and does not implement OnDestroy, so ngOnDestroy() would never be called during normal navigation. The polling interval continues firing every 5 seconds after logout because setNotConnected() does not call stopHostScreenUpdate(), and the @HostListener('window:beforeunload') in app.component.ts calls logout() without explicitly stopping the interval. While isThereError and !isConnected() guard clauses prevent API calls from being made after logout, the setInterval() callback continues to fire and check these flags repeatedly, wasting CPU cycles and event loop resources.
